author: RHammadi

title: GREAT but…
body:
I loved the app! It’s amazing, it’s got a lot of great and useful features, but the only upsetting thing is that you can’t make more than 2 routines. :(. To me, that’s very disappointing and makes me uncomfortable, as I cannot function with only 2 routines. I need one for holidays, school days, weekends, etc. so, it would be a really great update if you changed the maximum amount of routines into 5. 

Thanks a bunch and hope you enjoyed my completely honest review. :).

title: Amazing!! ✨
